meta.description: Resolves GWAS associations to candidate causal variants and credible sets through SuSiE, summary-statistic fine-mapping, FINEMAP, PolyFun, SuSiEx, DAP-G, LD diagnostics, and credible-set colocalization.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations, biological results, or statistics were found in the tested Skill outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill is a population-level research workflow and made no individual diagnostic, treatment, or prescriptive claims.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh Input 12 executed the shipped examples/susie_rss_finemap.R. Its own estimate_s_rss diagnostic was lambda=0.8314, above the Skill's >0.10 mismatch threshold, but it continued to fit, labelled three sets valid, and wrote results. This contradicts the Skill's instruction to diagnose LD mismatch before reporting credible sets.

code_usability.detail: All R and shell files parsed; the SuSiE, PolyFun, FINEMAP, SuSiEx, DAP-G, coloc.susie, and visualization paths executed and produced inspectable output. The Input 12 failure is methodological, not a syntax or dependency failure.

functional_suitability.note: The branch covers its declared major workflows and the repaired CLI paths, but the shipped summary-statistic example violates its own LD-diagnostic safety rule.

reliability.note: Clear mismatch diagnostics, naming preconditions, convergence checks, and common-error guidance exist, but the primary RSS example warns on a severe mismatch and then publishes output.

performance_context.note: The 300-line entrypoint uses nine focused references and runnable examples; large optional command-line tools remain conditional.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, tool-version notes, platform guidance, and common errors are strong. The contradictory runnable RSS example makes the safe next action ambiguous.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and concrete researcher scenarios are clear; strict validation is appropriate for this data-analysis workflow.

security.note: No credentials or sensitive-data handling were found. Shell examples assume trusted local file paths and user-provided configuration values.

maintainability.note: Technical depth is separated into references and examples, with current version notes. The duplicated diagnostic logic needs one corrected simulation pattern.

agent_specific.note: The Skill has precise triggers, progressive disclosure, and stop conditions, but Input 12 proves its executable default path bypasses a stated stop condition.

recommendations.title: RSS example reports after failed LD diagnostic
recommendations.problem: The shipped self-contained RSS example obtains lambda=0.8314 but continues to label credible sets valid and writes output, contradicting its stated lambda threshold and reporting rule.
recommendations.root_cause: The demo z-score bumps are not generated consistently with its LD matrix, and the warning path does not stop or mark all downstream results exploratory.
recommendations.fix: Generate z from the same LD matrix, for example z ~ N(R %*% true_z, R), and add a hard stop before credible-set extraction when lambda exceeds 0.10. Retain a separate intentional-mismatch example only if it refuses to report results.
